name: hermes
description: NousResearch Hermes weights as a local agent that speaks the fleet's AGENT contract. Inference runs on this box only — the llama_cpp package in-process, or a llama.cpp/ollama server on localhost — never a cloud API. GET /agents and POST /run/stream are the shape orbit/build probes before it will mount a module as an agent backend, so a hermes run can be a build job; orbit/agent mounts the same module as a free local provider, so any agent there can run on Hermes weights without a key or a credit balance.
title: Hermes ☿ Local Agent
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib) — no dependencies

agent_contract.run: POST /run/stream → SSE (model_start, token, tool_start, step, done)
agent_contract.provider: orbit/agent: provider `hermes` — local, free, never billed

env.HERMES_BACKEND: force one backend: llama-cpp | server (default: probe)
env.HERMES_BASH_TIMEOUT: seconds one bash tool call gets (default 120)

auth.open: GET /, /health, /agents, /models — the mount probe must not need a token
auth.run: owner bearer (~/.mod/hermes/server.secret), a loopback request that did not pass the gateway, or a mod-protocol token as `key` in the body
